```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Collapse published hazard classes to three bivariate bands.
// Use NDD for drought because monthly NDWS saturates across most African units.
S2_HAZARDS = new Object({
  drought: {
    code: "NDD-mean",
    column: "dryDays",
    breaks: [15, 20],
    label: nbText.s2HazardDrought,
    mapTitle: nbText.s2MapTitleDrought,
    severity: nbText.s2HazardDroughtSeverity,
  },
  waterlogging: {
    code: "NDWL0-mean",
    column: "waterloggingDays",
    breaks: [2, 5],
    label: nbText.s2HazardWaterlogging,
    mapTitle: nbText.s2MapTitleWaterlogging,
    severity: nbText.s2HazardWaterloggingSeverity,
  },
})

// Fetch the small hazard slice once; filteredData already scopes the later join.
hazardByAdmin = {
  const bind = createSqlBindings();
  const rows = await db.query(
    `
    SELECT
      admin0_name,
      admin1_name,
      admin2_name,
      hazard,
      value
    FROM hazard_data
    WHERE iso3 IN (${bind.list([...iso3Set])})
      AND hazard IN (${bind.list(Object.values(S2_HAZARDS).map((h) => h.code))})
      AND stat = ${bind.value("mean")}
  `,
    bind.params
  );

  // Pivot mean-only hazard rows into a direct admin-unit lookup.
  const byAdmin = new Map();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const key = `${row.admin0_name}|${row.admin1_name}|${row.admin2_name}`;
    const unit = byAdmin.get(key) ?? {};
    const hazard = Object.values(S2_HAZARDS).find((h) => h.code === row.hazard);
    if (hazard) unit[hazard.column] = parseFloat(row.value);
    byAdmin.set(key, unit);
  }
  return byAdmin;
}

combinedData = {
  const hazardColumns = Object.values(S2_HAZARDS).map((h) => h.column);

  return filteredData
    .map((cis) => {
      const hazard =
        hazardByAdmin.get(`${cis.admin0_name}|${cis.admin1_name}|${cis.admin2_name}`) ?? {};

      return {
        ...cis,
        ...Object.fromEntries(hazardColumns.map((col) => [col, hazard[col] ?? null])),
      };
    })
    .filter((d) => hazardColumns.some((col) => d[col] !== null));
}

// Classify readiness × hazard on the 3×3 palette; missing hazards remain no-data.

function bivariateClassify(readiness, hazardValue, hazardKey, readinessLevel = currentAdminLevel) {

// Comparisons against NaN are all false, so missing values have to be caught
// before the ladder — otherwise they fall through to the most severe class.
  const readinessClass = classifyThreshold("cis_readiness_index", readiness, readinessLevel);

  const numeric = Number(hazardValue);
  const [moderate, severe] = S2_HAZARDS[hazardKey].breaks;
  const hazardClass =
    hazardValue == null || Number.isNaN(numeric)
      ? "No data"
      : numeric < moderate
      ? "Low"
      : numeric < severe
      ? "Moderate"
      : "High";

  return {
    readinessClass,
    hazardClass,
    bivariateClass: hazardClass === "No data" ? "No data" : `${readinessClass} × ${hazardClass}`,
  };
}

// Colour only. What each cell means, and how the cells rank, is policy: see
// bivariatePriority in data/cis/thresholds.json and the s2Priority* strings.
// x = readiness (purple), y = hazard (green).
bivariatePalette = bivariatePalettes.purpleGreen

// The maps still fill by the bivariateClass string, and thresholds.json ranks by
// the same key, so name the palette cells for them. Indices stay the source of
// truth: nothing here is joined on a translated word.
BIVARIATE_CLASSES = ["Low", "Moderate", "High"]

bivariateColors = Object.fromEntries([
  ...bivariatePalette.map((cell) => [
    `${BIVARIATE_CLASSES[cell.x]} × ${BIVARIATE_CLASSES[cell.y]}`,
    cell.color,
  ]),
  // Unfilled rather than grey: the palette's own low-low cell is #e8e8e8, so a
  // grey no-data class would be indistinguishable from "low readiness, low
  // hazard". Its outline below is what keeps the unit visible.
  ["No data", "#fff"],
])
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

s2ProcessedData = {
  const hazardColumn = S2_HAZARDS[s2HazardType].column;

  return combinedData
    .filter((d) => d.cis_readiness_index != null && d[hazardColumn] !== null)
    .map((d) => {
      const classified = bivariateClassify(d.cis_readiness_index, d[hazardColumn], s2HazardType, d);

      return {
        ...d,
        hazardValue: d[hazardColumn],
        ...classified,
      };
    });
}

s2MapData = {
  const level = currentAdminLevel; //TODO: This filtering has to go / be re-used across notebook

  if (level === 0) {
    const grouped = d3.group(s2ProcessedData, (d) => d.gaul0_code);
    return Array.from(grouped.values()).map((group) => {
      const first = group[0];
      const avgReadiness = d3.mean(group, (d) => d.cis_readiness_index);
      const avgHazard = d3.mean(group, (d) => d.hazardValue);
      const classified = bivariateClassify(avgReadiness, avgHazard, s2HazardType, 0);

      return {
        admin0_name: first.admin0_name,
        iso3: first.iso3,
        gaul0_code: first.gaul0_code,
        cis_readiness_index: avgReadiness,
        hazardValue: avgHazard,
        ...classified,
      };
    });
  } else if (level === 1) {
    const grouped = d3.group(s2ProcessedData, (d) => d.gaul1_code);
    return Array.from(grouped.values()).map((group) => {
      const first = group[0];
      const avgReadiness = d3.mean(group, (d) => d.cis_readiness_index);
      const avgHazard = d3.mean(group, (d) => d.hazardValue);
      const classified = bivariateClassify(avgReadiness, avgHazard, s2HazardType, 1);

      return {
        admin0_name: first.admin0_name,
        admin1_name: first.admin1_name,
        iso3: first.iso3,
        gaul0_code: first.gaul0_code,
        gaul1_code: first.gaul1_code,
        cis_readiness_index: avgReadiness,
        hazardValue: avgHazard,
        ...classified,
      };
    });
  } else {
    return s2ProcessedData;
  }
}

// Join at the resolved admin level and retain unmatched no-data features.
s2GeoData = ({
  type: "FeatureCollection",
  features: buildLevelFeatures((row) => ({ ...(row || {}), hasData: Boolean(row) }), s2MapData),
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

s2BivariateMap = {
  if (s2ViewToggle !== "map") return null;
  const hazardName = S2_HAZARDS[s2HazardType].label;

  return makeChoropleth({
    features: s2GeoData,
    width: 775,
    height: 610,
    projection: "mercator",
    fill: (d) => (d.properties.hasData ? d.properties.bivariateClass : "No data"),
    color: {
      type: "categorical",
      legend: false,
      // Insertion order of the palette is the class order the legend expects.
      domain: Object.keys(bivariateColors),
      range: Object.values(bivariateColors),
      label: "Bivariate Class",
    },
    channels: {
      region: {
        label: "Region",
        value: (d) =>
          currentAdminLevel === 0
            ? d.properties.admin0_name
            : currentAdminLevel === 1
            ? `${d.properties.admin1_name}, ${d.properties.admin0_name}`
            : `${d.properties.admin2_name}, ${d.properties.admin1_name}`,
      },
      readiness: {
        label: "Readiness (0-1)",
        value: (d) => fmt(d.properties.cis_readiness_index, 2),
      },
      hazard: {
        label: hazardName,
        value: (d) => fmt(d.properties.hazardValue, 1),
      },
      bivariateClass: {
        label: "Bivariate class",
        value: (d) => d.properties.bivariateClass || "N/A",
      },
    },
    tooltip: {
      region: true,
      readiness: true,
      hazard: true,
      bivariateClass: true,
    },
    baseMarkOptions: {
      stroke: (d) => (d.properties.hasData ? "#fff" : "#bbb"),
    },
    adminHighlight,
  });
}

s2Figure = {
  if (s2ViewToggle === "map") {
    return bivariateMapWithLegend(s2BivariateMap, {
      ...CIS_BIVARIATE_LEGEND,
      yLabel: S2_HAZARDS[s2HazardType].severity,
    });
  } else {
    const hazardName = S2_HAZARDS[s2HazardType].label;

    const tableData = s2MapData.map((d) => {
      const adminName = adminDisplayName(d);

      // Policy rankings come from thresholds.json; wording stays localized.
      // High readiness × high hazard ranks action potential, not warning severity.
      const priority = bivariatePriority[d.bivariateClass] ?? {
        rank: 0,
        textKey: "s2PriorityLow",
      };

      return {
        adminName: adminName,
        readinessRaw: d.cis_readiness_index,
        readinessClass: d.readinessClass,
        hazardRaw: d.hazardValue,
        hazardClass: d.hazardClass,
        bivariateClass: d.bivariateClass,
        priorityRank: priority.rank,
        priorityLevel: nbText[priority.textKey],
      };
    });

    return filterableDataTable(tableData, {
      columns: [
        "adminName",
        "readinessRaw",
        "readinessClass",
        "hazardRaw",
        "hazardClass",
        "priorityLevel",
      ],
      header: {
        adminName: "Admin Name",
        readinessRaw: "CIS Readiness",
        readinessClass: "Readiness Class",
        hazardRaw: hazardName,
        hazardClass: "Hazard Class",
        priorityLevel: nbText.s2PriorityColumn,
      },
      format: {
        readinessRaw: (d) => d.toFixed(2),
        hazardRaw: (d) => d.toFixed(1),
      },
      sort: "priorityRank",
      reverse: true,
    });
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

s2Insights = {
  const hazard = S2_HAZARDS[s2HazardType].label;
  const area = breadcrumb;
  const insightData = onlySelectedAtLevel(s2MapData);

  // Keep empty, zero-potential, and positive-potential messages distinct.
  const highHigh = insightData.filter((d) => d.bivariateClass === "High × High");
  const opportunity =
    insightData.length === 0
      ? tmpl(nbText.insights.s2NoData, { area })
      : highHigh.length === 0
      ? tmpl(nbText.insights.s2NoOpportunity, { area, hazard })
      : tmpl(nbText.insights.s2Opportunity, {
          area,
          hazard,
          percent: ((highHigh.length / insightData.length) * 100).toFixed(1),
        });

  // No high-hazard areas is different from a 0% readiness gap.
  const highHazard = insightData.filter((d) => d.hazardClass === "High");
  const lowReadiness = highHazard.filter((d) => d.readinessClass === "Low");
  const gap =
    highHazard.length === 0
      ? tmpl(nbText.insights.s2NoHighHazard, { area, hazard })
      : tmpl(nbText.insights.s2Gap, {
          hazard,
          percent: ((lowReadiness.length / highHazard.length) * 100).toFixed(1),
        });

  return html`
    <div style="background: #f8f9fa; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 20px;">
      <h4 style="margin-top: 0;">${nbText.s2InsightsHeading}</h4>
      <p style="margin: 10px 0;">
        <strong>${nbText.s2OpportunityLabel}:</strong> ${md([opportunity])}
      </p>
      <p style="margin: 10px 0;"><strong>${nbText.s2GapLabel}:</strong> ${md([gap])}</p>
    </div>
  `;
}
```
